verdict.rationale: Mailgun documents open and click tracking, SDKs to track email, and real-time event webhooks. Community users praise its logging and debugging dashboards. The pack never explicitly documents an API endpoint for querying a per-message event history, so the 'what happened to this email?' lookup is only implied. Missing for 10: documented events/logs query API with per-message filtering, details of event types and retention, hands-on corroboration of per-message lookups via the API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can track opens and clicks and query a per-message event history via the API to answer 'what happened to this email?'

citations.quote: Open and Click Tracking | Monitor who opens your emails and clicks on links, providing insights into recipient engagement.
Get real-time email event data sent directly to your application.
Our SDKs support multiple programming languages, allowing you to seamlessly send, receive, and track emails within your applications.
Mailgun's logging is great, and includes the full-text of messages.
